title: Chaolux
description: A shielding plate that halves all damage and acts as a one-time totem, balancing defense and survival in combat.
body: ### 📜Description Chaolux introduces a powerful shielding plate that halves all incoming damage and can be consumed as a one-time totem for survival. Designed to seamlessly integrate with vanilla combat mechanics, this mod enhances both defense and strategic gameplay.   ### 🎉Features * Damage Reduction – The plate halves all damage from any source while equipped. * Totem Effect – Once fully depleted, it acts as a one-time revival tool.   ### 📃Long Description Chaolux introduces a unique shielding plate, designed to provide enhanced protection while keeping the game balanced. When equipped, it reduces all incoming damage by 50%, making it a powerful defensive tool in combat, exploration, and high-risk situations.   Additionally, when the plate absorbs its final hit, it breaks and grants a second chance similar to a Totem of Undying, making it a lifesaving last resort. This creates a strategic trade-off between long-term protection and emergency revival, making it a versatile item for both cautious and daring players.
